highlights: If your Claude agents use your own CLAUDE.md, skills or hooks, turn on Use my Claude Code setup in Settings → Providers → Claude.
Put your agents on the new agent dock at the edge of your Mac screen, and chat with them from there.
Agents now write short updates while they work. Choose Classic in Server settings to keep the old style.
Members of a joined server can add their own MCP servers and connect apps such as Trello.
Attach a file of any type to a chat, and send files of up to 100 MB from the web app.
